name: SIP Calculator
summary: Estimate SIP maturity value, total invested, and returns from monthly contributions — locally.
description: Enter monthly investment, expected annual return, and tenure in years. See projected maturity value, total invested, estimated returns, and an optional year-by-year schedule. Uses the common SIP annuity-due formula (monthly compounding).

faqs.question: Which SIP formula is used?
faqs.answer: The common Indian SIP (annuity-due) formula: FV = P × (((1+i)^n − 1) / i) × (1+i), where i is the monthly rate and n is the number of months.

faqs.question: Are returns guaranteed?
faqs.answer: No. Expected return is an assumption you enter. Real mutual fund performance varies and this is not investment advice.

faqs.question: Can expected return be zero?
faqs.answer: Yes. At 0%, maturity equals total invested (monthly amount × months).

faqs.question: Is my data uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Calculations run entirely in your browser.
